n: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Antarvedi
x: Lakshmi Narasimha Temple is a Hindu temple in Antarvedi, Sakhinetipalle mandal, Konaseema district, Andhra Pradesh, India. The temple is situated at the place where the Bay of Bengal and Vashista Godavari, a tributary of the Godavari River, meet. It was built in the 15th and 16th centuries.
Perupalem Beach is located on the coast of Bay of Bengal, in West Godavari district of the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
Yanam Beach is situated on the coast of Yanam town, an Indian territory of Puducherry. The beach is located on the Godavari River, 9 kilometres from the Bay of Bengal.

Ksheerarama is one of the five Pancharama Kshetras that are sacred to the Hindu god Shiva. The temple is located in Palakollu of West Godavari in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. Shiva is known locally as Ksheera Ramalingeswara Swamy.
Ramayapatnam Beach is located on the coast of Bay of Bengal, in Prakasam district of the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.

Christ Lutheran Church is a congregation in the Andhra Evangelical Lutheran Church and is a member church of the West Godavari Synod. It is an A class parish and is a mother church to several smaller and younger congregations in and around Narsapur, West Godavari. Its pastors are pastor V. Rajendra Sundar and Assistant pastor P.P.S.kiran.
